{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now compute the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
total_patients = len(df_dedup)
severe_patients = df_dedup['severity'].eq('severe').sum()
fraction_severe = severe_patients / total_patients

fraction_severe"}
